scenario: the first practical exchange about daily routines
english_title: Recognising and Responding to the First Practical Exchange About Daily Routines
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: daily routines — the first practical exchange about daily routines
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to the first practical exchange about daily routines; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Emma asks Ms Lan what time she usually has dinner.
context_note_vi: Chị Emma hỏi chị Lan thường ăn tối lúc mấy giờ.

turns.speaker: Ms Emma
turns.english: Lan, what time do you usually have dinner?
turns.vietnamese: Lan này, chị thường ăn tối lúc mấy giờ?

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: I usually have dinner at seven thirty.
turns.vietnamese: Tôi thường ăn tối lúc bảy giờ rưỡi.

turns.speaker: Ms Emma
turns.vietnamese: Bảy giờ rưỡi à. Nghe hay đấy.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.vietnamese: Vâng, tôi thích giờ đó lắm.
